l3_car_t_second_line.quote: Refer now for CD19-directed CAR-T cell therapy, with axicabtagene ciloleucel (axi-cel) as the preferred product and liso-cel as an acceptable alternative depending on center access

l3_why_early_relapse.quote: In ZUMA-7, axi-cel improved event-free and overall survival compared with standard salvage chemotherapy followed by autologous transplant in transplant-eligible patients with primary refractory or early-relapsed DLBCL

l3_cd19_confirmed.quote: CD19 expression confirmed by IHC and flow

l3_no_more_drugs.quote: Tell him honestly that adding more drugs now is unlikely to improve his chances and could make CAR-T harder to deliver.

l3_avoid_bendamustine.quote: Avoid bendamustine and high-dose dexamethasone-based regimens, both for T-cell reasons and because of his diabetes.

l3_ngs_interpretation.quote: The pattern is typical of germinal-center lymphoma with epigenetic-modifier mutations (EZH2 together with CREBBP and KMT2D loss).

l3_tazemetostat_context.quote: Tazemetostat is approved for EZH2-mutant follicular lymphoma and for epithelioid sarcoma, not for DLBCL, so using it here would be off-label, and EZH2-inhibitor combinations are being studied in trials.

l3_mn_rice_asct_preferred.quote: Salvage followed by autologous transplant is not recommended as the main plan, because primary refractory disease rarely becomes durable remission with that approach.

l3_mn_tazemetostat_instead.quote: Trial referral is worthwhile as a backup, but this does not justify off-label therapy now.

l3_mn_palliative.quote: Explain that CAR-T is the one route with a realistic chance of cure, and that the bridge is there to get him there.
